entries.zh: 立邊去：站到一邊去、往旁邊讓開
entries.en: to step to one side; to move aside

entries.zh: 散散：彼此散開、四散分離
entries.en: to scatter apart; to separate from one another

entries.zh: 相離：相互分離、彼此離開
entries.en: to part from each other; to separate from one another

entries.zh: 拆散：拆散開、使（家庭、團體）分離
entries.en: to break up, to split apart (a family, a group)

entries.zh: 拆開去：拆開、分開而離去
entries.en: to pull apart; to separate and go away

entries.zh: 拆單：把帳目或份額分開另計；特意分開
entries.en: to split up (an account, a share); to separate on purpose
entries.notes: L「aposta」（故意）与 H 拆單（分帳）的语义衔接靠推断；M 与第 4 条同形，疑有漏录。

entries.zh: 拆離：拆開而使分離
entries.en: to pull apart; to separate, to part

entries.zh: 脩（修）道：離開世俗、入修道生活
entries.en: to withdraw from the world into religious life; to cultivate the Way

entries.zh: 退邊：退到一邊、往旁邊讓開
entries.en: to draw back to one side; to step aside
entries.notes: R 首音节 hùi 与 H 退 不相应，疑异读或误录；L 与 H 义合，取「退到一边」。

entries.zh: 拖開：拖拉使分開、拖到一邊
entries.en: to drag apart; to haul away

entries.zh: 非理：違背道理、不合情理
entries.en: to stray from reason; to be unreasonable

entries.zh: 非義：不合義理、不義
entries.en: to stray from righteousness; to be unrighteous

entries.zh: 另：分開的、另外的
entries.en: separate, apart; other

entries.zh: 另居：分開另住、獨自居住
entries.en: to live apart; to dwell separately

entries.zh: 走樣：變形、失卻原樣（偏離應有的樣式）
entries.en: to lose shape; to deviate from the proper form
entries.notes: L 栏文字重复紊乱（«del modo delos buen del modo delos modos»），依 H 走樣、R 对音定「失却原样」。

entries.zh: 除：除去、趕出去
entries.en: to remove; to cast out, to expel

entries.zh: 除斷：徹底除去、斷絕（交情）
entries.en: to cut off entirely; to sever (a friendship)

entries.zh: 遠：遠離、疏遠
entries.en: to be far off; to distance oneself
entries.notes: L 栏 «despedirse, irse a acompanasse con el» 语义紊乱，H 遠 与 R inèn 互证，取「远离」。

entries.zh: 遠棄：疏遠並拋棄、斷絕往來
entries.en: to cast off, to reject; to break off (friendship)

entries.zh: 出頭占伊：出面爭取占有（對某物的熱衷）
entries.en: to put oneself forward to claim something; to be passionately eager for it
entries.notes: «gst» 推为 gusto（喜好）；R 末音节 chièng 与 H 占/伊 不合，释义据 H 出頭占伊 定。

entries.zh: 落霜：下霜、結霜
entries.en: frost; for frost to fall
entries.notes: L 栏 [空]，西语词头不明；H/M/R 三栏一致作「落霜」，故仍出义而降为中。

entries.zh: 落雹：下冰雹、（亦指）雹
entries.en: to hail; hail, hailstone shower
entries.notes: M 栏尾部 yūd rog gog 无对应音节，疑衍录；H 落雹、R lò paû 一致。

entries.zh: 訴：上訴、告狀申訴
entries.en: to appeal (to a higher court); to lodge a complaint, to sue
